import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('test', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('http://localhost:8080/sap/bc/gui/sap/its/webgui');
  await page.getByLabel('Email').click();
  await page.getByLabel('Email').fill('rpa-bot@rpa.example');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next' }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Password').click();
  await page.getByLabel('Password').fill('idp-demo-password');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in' }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Code').click();
  await page.getByLabel('Code').fill('482913');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Verify' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'No', exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Line Item Report' }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('Company Code').click();
  await page.getByLabel('Company Code').fill('1000');
  await page.getByLabel('From').click();
  await page.getByLabel('From').fill('01.09.2026');
  await page.getByLabel('To', { exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByLabel('To', { exact: true }).fill('30.09.2026');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Execute (F8)' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Spreadsheet... (Ctrl+Shift+F7)' }).click();
  const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Continue (Enter)' }).click();
  const download = await downloadPromise;
});
